# xfo-miner v1.0.12

This hotfix corrects XMRig share-summary parsing introduced in v1.0.11 so normal startup lines cannot be interpreted as high rejection.

## Highlights

- Fixes XMRig summary parsing to treat `(accepted/rejected)` correctly.
- Prevents startup summaries such as `accepted (3/0)` from triggering the reject-rate restart watchdog.
- Keeps the v1.0.11 high reject-rate recovery behavior for real high-rejection cases.

## Scope

### XMRig reject-rate parsing hotfix

- `internal/scheduler/xmrig.go` now parses XMRig share summaries as accepted/rejected counts.
- Reject-rate calculation remains `rejected / (accepted + rejected)` and still requires the configured minimum share threshold.
- Debug mode remains OTA-disabled only; this fix addresses the watchdog restart path that could stop and restart XMRig after misparsed share summaries.

## Validation

- Verified with:
  - `gofmt -w cmd/xfo-miner/main.go internal/scheduler/xmrig.go internal/scheduler/xmrig_test.go`
  - `go test ./internal/scheduler`
  - `go test ./...`
  - `go vet ./...`
  - `go build ./cmd/xfo-miner`
  - `git --no-pager diff --check -- cmd/xfo-miner/main.go internal/scheduler/xmrig.go internal/scheduler/xmrig_test.go .github/releases/v1.0.12.md`

## Operator notes

- Upgrade from v1.0.11 to v1.0.12 immediately if CPU mining is enabled.
- `accepted (3/0)` now parses as three accepted shares and zero rejected shares.
- A restart still occurs when the rejected share ratio is strictly greater than 10% after enough share samples are present.
